snapshot_numeric_format: all public binary64 numbers encoded by big-endian16 lowercase hex digits; reject NaN/inf, negative times/sizes, nonpositive estimates/bandwidth; normalize -0
record_rule: Preserve every actual event record, including EMPTY_DISPATCH and duplicate state references; contiguous event_seq, verified hook stream receipt.
hooks: INITIAL; after a full D1 completion+arrival batch before dispatch; after each actual start before next call; empty-dispatch outcome; post-completion final refresh. Never expose an intermediate completion-only view before same-time arrivals.
dedup_scope: One primary attempt of one MAIN B2 trial; denominator scope hash includes run_id, primary_attempt_id, observer_spec_sha256. No pooling across trials/seeds/methods/controls/replays.
state_key: SHA256 canonical STATE_KEY_PREIMAGE(scope hash,state_sha256); record ID/event_seq/decision_seq are not state-equivalence keys
counting: Globally dedup identical state_key within scope; first event_seq is representative, later events link to counted_as_event_seq. now/elapsed are included, so genuine time advance changes state; same-time start/completion/arrival changes public status/DAG and counts distinctly.
empty_calls: Preserve empty calls; same snapshot counts once. A unique state with no ready action or no pending H target is NOT_IN_SCOPE, not a zero-opportunity eligible state.
replay: Replay has separate stream_role=REPLAY and receipt, never contributes denominator; public-state hash sequence must reproduce primary including same-time transitions. Record IDs can differ.
missing: Any expected hook/snapshot/reference/required field missing or corrupt is INCOMPLETE/INVALID evidence; cannot decide eligibility and silently exclude it. Fail closed; no zero imputation.
independent_check: Reconstruct hook coverage from validated physical/decision trace and observer contract; check all refs/state hashes, earliest representative and scope membership, then recompute E/F/coverage/hits from complete primary stream.
exact_event_rule: Exactly one SNAPSHOT_EVENT for each actual engine scheduler invocation: body is pre-call public view, dispatch_result records returned START/NONE. event_seq and decision_seq are the contiguous0-based invocation index within stream; causes are unique in listed enum order. EMPTY_DISPATCH is metadata on that event, not an extra observation. Final completion must have a final empty call/view as the existing P1 engine does; no synthetic polling calls may be inserted.
duplicate_event_rule: Duplicate event ID in an exported stream is integrity failure, even if byte-identical; multiple genuinely executed calls with different event IDs and same state_sha are retained but state counted once.
derived_public_metadata: template_id and size derived only from arrived service public IDs/DAG node count; do not add private fields or change scheduler DTO. Running elapsed must equal RN64(now-start) as existing engine; arrays sorted as declared.
